P1: 21号道路 is an ocean route that leads southward from 真新镇 to 红莲岛.
D1:
* On the northeastern-most sandbar (hidden)
* On the large sandbar in the middle of the route (hidden; ×2)
P2: Cinnabar is a large island to the southwest of mainland Kanto, between Routes 21号道路 and 20号道路. The area once held a research facility, the broken-down former home of a famous researcher, and the Cinnabar Gym.
D3: Center of the island; on a lone rock (hidden; requires 攀岩)
D4: Northwest corner of the island, on a lone rock (hidden; requires 攀岩)
D5: South-central part of the island, on a lone rock (hidden; requires 攀岩)
D6: Northeast of the Pokémon Center, above the ledge (requires 攀岩)
P3: When the island's volcano erupted, most buildings were either buried in rubble or swept into the sea, and only the Pokémon Center has since been rebuilt. According to a Sailor inside the building, it has been a year since the eruption. A sign posted outside notifies visitors that the Cinnabar Gym has relocated to the nearby 双子岛.
P4: Speak to the man behind the Pokémon Center, and he introduces himself as 青绿. He is not in the mood to battle at the moment, as he contemplates the power of nature and the destruction around him. Regardless, he says that as a Trainer, seeing a strong opponent still makes him want to battle. He asks to see how many Badges you have earned, and seeing that you only have six, says that you are not yet ready to battle him.
P5: The waves of 20号道路 are a popular spot for swimming. The middle of the path is occupied by the 双子岛. The waters lead east to 19号道路.
D7: Northeast end of the long, narrow sandbar (hidden)
D8: South-central area, in the waters to the southeast of the Seafoam Islands (hidden)
D9: North-central area, in the waters to the northwest of the Seafoam Islands (hidden)
P6: The 双子岛 are a pair of islands that are shaped the same, as if they were twins. A shocking cold fills the caverns inside. Several large boulders and fast-moving currents hinder travel at first.
D11: On a rock, north of the ladder to Cinnabar Gym (hidden)
D14:
* Central area, west side of the large lighter-colored patch of ground (hidden)
* Northeast area, on the rocky ridge
D16: Lower; south-central area, above a ledge, accessible via B1F
D17:
* Lower; northwest area, on the western-most of two icy stalagmites (hidden)
* Upper; on the left-hand stalagmite at the east end of the bridge (hidden)
D19: Lower; southeast area, on the rock wall between two icy stalagmites on the lower level (hidden)
D20: Lower; north-central area, beyond two ice patches covered with ice blocks
D21: Upper; on a lone stalagmite near the northwest ladder (hidden)
D24: North; on a rocky ridge in the north-central area, accessed via B3F
D25: East; on the large eastern ridge, accessible via B3F
D26: Center; on the spot where Articuno stood (hidden)
P7: The path diverges inside the eastern island. A ladder leads to an upper chamber that houses the relocated Cinnabar Gym, while an ice-encrusted stairway leads down into the heart of the 双子岛.
P8: The Cinnabar Gym specializes in 火 Pokémon. Fire-type moves are super effective against 虫-, 草-, 冰-, and 钢 Pokémon, while Fire-type Pokémon are weak to 地面-, 岩石-, and 水 moves.
P9: The chamber features red, orange, and yellow floor tiles arranged in the shape of a flame, and a large number of rocks left over from its conversion into a makeshift Gym. These rocks force challengers to pass through several chokepoints, each one guarded by a Gym Trainer. Defeating a Gym Trainer causes him to move out of the way, allowing challengers to continue to the Gym Leader.
P10: Blaine's 熔岩蜗牛 has high 防御, so special moves will fare better against it. Due to its Rock typing, 水 attacks will be especially useful. Intending to account for one of his team's weaknesses, Blaine has taught his 鸭嘴火兽 雷电拳 in order to fight back against Water Pokémon. 烈焰马 has high 速度, and a high physical 攻击 lets it deal massive damage with 闪焰冲锋. All of Blaine's Pokémon know 过热, an incredibly powerful move that cuts the user's 特攻 by 50% after each use. To avoid this, each Pokémon holds a 白色香草, which restores any lowered stat when consumed. Be sure to bring some 灼伤药s.
P11: After the battle, Blaine awards you the 深红徽章. He also gives out 招式学习器50（过热） as a prize. Climb back down the ladder and walk down the icy stairway to fully explore the islands.
P12: Go north to reach a group of three boulders. Use 怪力 to move the right-hand boulder westward, then the left-hand boulder northward, and then the middle boulder eastward. This clears a path to the north-central area and a 紧缠钩爪. Return to the three boulders and turn west, then climb down the western-most ladder on the lower level.
P13: Pick up the nearby 水之石, then jump the ledge and climb up the ladder to the east.
P14: Go north and walk up onto the rocky ridge. Collect the 解冻药, then climb down the ladder to the west.
P15: Walk down the stairway, then slide northward over the first ice patch. Turn east and battle past Skier Cady and Boarder Shaun on the second ice patch. At the third ice patch, slide southward to fight Boarder Bryce, then slide eastward and climb down the northeast ladder.
P16: Move southwestward around the first ice patch, then use 怪力 to push the nearby boulder two steps northward. Return to the ladder and slide westward over the ice to reach the boulder, then slide north and climb down the ladder.
P17: Pick up the 高级球 and climb back up the ladder.
P18: Slide southward over the ice patch, then climb down the southeast ladder.
P19: Go north to find 招式学习器13（冰冻光束）, then climb back up the ladder.
P20: Move westward to reach an ice patch with three blocks of ice. Two of these three blocks must be cleared to proceed. Slide into them from the north or south to send them skidding away. Slide into the final block from the east side; this moves it to a small alcove. Slide westward, then continue on through the narrow passage. Pass by the ladder to reach another ice patch. Bump into the northeast block from the south, then push the northwest block from the west. Approach the ice patch from the south and slide to the northern-most block, then move in a clockwise direction to reach the 大珍珠. Climb down the ladder to the southwest.
P21: The lowest level is filled with large rocks that hinder travel. Use 冲浪 to move northward to the next ridge, then continue eastward and climb up the ladder on the central ridge.
P23: Move southeastward over the bridge and climb down the southeast ladder.
P25: Use 冲浪 to continue westward. Climb up onto the south-central ridge to find 急冻鸟, the first of Kanto's three legendary birds.
P26: Begin with 火-, 电-, and 钢 attacks to wear its health down quickly, then follow up with 虫 and 草 moves to chip away at it even further. Consider inflicting status ailments like 睡眠 and 麻痹 to restrict its movements, and be sure to bring along some healing items as well.
P27: Afterward, use 冲浪 again to reach the northwest ridge and climb up the ladder there.
P28: Go south then east to reach a 活力碎片, then backtrack and climb up the southwest ladder.
P30: Move northward and use 怪力 to clear a path. Climb up the icy stairway to the northwest.
P31: The western exit lies to the south.
P32: 19号道路 runs north from 20号道路 back to 浅红市. It is a popular spot for swimming and sunbathing.
D27: On the sandy islet to the southeast (requires 冲浪)
D28: On the spot where TM55 was found (hidden; requires 冲浪)
D29:
* Two steps west of the sign at the water's edge (hidden; requires 冲浪)
* Southeast corner of the beach, on a small rock (hidden; requires 冲浪)
D30: Northeast of the beach, on the rock wall betwen two small rocks (hidden; requires 冲浪)
D31: Southeast of the Fuchsia City gate, behind two breakable rocks (hidden; requires 碎岩)
P33: In the time it took to return to the beach outside 浅红市, the volcanic debris has been cleared away. Travelers can now move freely between Fuchsia City and 19号道路.
P34: 飞翔 back to 红莲岛 and speak to 青绿. Now that you have earned the seven other Kanto Badges, he invites you to face him in Viridian Gym, then leaves. The stage is set for the final Gym battle!
